title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Article 7 of Annex I and Article 3 of Annex II to the Basic Law of the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: 1. The statement "if amendment is needed" regarding the methods for selecting the Chief Executive and for forming the Legislative Council for the year 2009 and thereafter, as prescribed in the two Annexes mentioned above, means that such methods may be amended, or may not be amended.

2. The requirement, as prescribed in the two Annexes mentioned above, that the amendment shall be passed by a two-thirds majority of all members of the Legislative Council, be consented to by the Chief Executive, and be reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for approval or record, refers to the mandatory legal procedure for amending the method for selecting the Chief Executive and the method for forming the Legislative Council. Only after undergoing the aforementioned procedure, including the final approval or record by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress according to law, may such amendment take effect. As to whether amendment is necessary, the Chief Executive of the Macao Special Administrative Region shall submit a report to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, which shall, in accordance with the provisions of Articles 47 and 68 of the Basic Law of the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, determine the matter based on the actual circumstances of the Macao Special Administrative Region. The bill to amend the method for selecting the Chief Executive and the method for forming the Legislative Council shall be introduced by the Government of the Macao Special Administrative Region to the Legislative Council.

3. If the method for selecting the Chief Executive and the method for forming the Legislative Council, as prescribed in the two Annexes mentioned above, are not amended, the method for selecting the Chief Executive shall continue to apply the provisions of Annex I regarding the method for selecting the Chief Executive; and the method for forming the Legislative Council shall continue to apply the provisions of Annex II regarding the method for forming the Legislative Council.
It is hereby proclaimed.
